title: Figures 6-7: renderings of LANL magnetized target fusion and dense plasma focus
description: Two digital illustrations. Figure 6, "Magnetized Target Fusion Experiment at LANL," is a cutaway rendering with labels for preheated fuel, plasma injector, liner implosion system and "Compressed to thermonuclear conditions." Figure 7, "Dense Plasma Focus (Lawrenceville Plasma Physics)," is a 3D rendering of copper electrodes around a central anode with swirling blue plasma filaments on a black background.
